maya: AM drop-in — pushed a small kernel patch to reduce batcher lock hold time (PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/1423). Quick summary: isolated lock scope + switched a couple of slot counters to atomics. Microbench: p95 down ~3.8% on 8k seq, p99 looks stable.

What I did: isolated lock, updated bookkeeping, ran local microbench.
Blockers: need a short canary run on Dedicated; saw one rare OOM on a huge-batch stress run (trying to repro).
Today: add canary config + smoke tests, address any CVs in PR, follow-up on OOM trace.

josh: nice. can you paste the bench command you used? want to reproduce quickly.

maya: bench command I used:```bash
wrk -t12 -c200 -d30s --latency 'https://staging.redwood/api/v1/gen?model=gptx-8k' --hdr 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'
```
Also ran our harness:```
./tools/bench/run_bench --profile kernel-lock --seq 8000 --concurrency 32
```

li: for the Dedicated canary, add `--max-batch-size=2048` and set kv-prefill=0 for first pass. also enable telemetry: `--trace-prefetch` so we can see prefetch stalls.

sasha: does this change affect KV cache eviction? we had a regression last week when prefetch + batching overlapped.

maya: good question — patch doesn't touch KV eviction logic directly, but reducing lock time can change timing so prefetch waits show up differently. small log excerpt from the stress run:```
[2026-03-17 08:12:04] slot=23 wait_prefetch=12ms batch_lock=1.3ms kv_hit=true
```
I'll add a micro-sleep in prefetch path for the canary so we can measure.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary build 2026-03-17_08:30 queued to dedicated-canary-3. ETA ~10m. <@maya> tagged.

josh: on review now. will leave a nit about atomic ordering and then spin a canary in eu-west to compare tail latencies.

maya: thanks — assigning review to @josh and @li. I'll add a smoke test that hits the canary endpoint:```bash
curl -sS -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"prompt":"hi"}' https://canary.redwood/api/v1/gen
```
and post results to this thread.

sasha: if the OOM reproduces, try `--shard-buffer-limit=256MB` on the canary to force earlier eviction and get a clearer trace.

maya: good plan — will run two canaries (baseline + shard-buffer tweak) and share perf + logs. ETA ~11:20 PT. :thumbsup:
